about: Spec 008's answer key, written by hand from FR-003 to FR-016 and research R2 to R7 (not from the code's output). Keyed by fixture file name; every file is a live capture from the 2026-10-26 sitting (specs/008-speed-graph/live-sitting-2026-10-26.md), and the stand-ins are gone. Changed on T031 where the live capture differs from what the stand-ins assumed and is what After Effects plays; each change says so in its entry's note. 'analysis' is what speed_graph_snapshot's analyzer gives with no options; 'check' is what speed_graph_check gives against the baseline with the baseline's US1 targets, after any 'demo' and with any 'seen_shaped'. A target not listed under a check's 'pairs' is 'untouched'. Fastest parts by research R2 on the live values (peaks: Easy Ease 0.5, 15/80 0.13, demo 0.13, the learner's own 18.49/83.63 0.15, 90/95 0.48, Position dragged up a little 0.52, Scale dragged up a little 0.56, Position dragged up a lot 0.65 (within 0.05 of the two-thirds line, so middle and last), Scale dragged up a lot 0.60, a hold landing read at its stored 33.333/16.667 0.66). Times are as AE stores them: Title Position's last key is at 4.367 s, not 4.37.

practice-before.json.note: mentor/test/fixtures/practice-before.json, Mentor Practice as built (no key values): only Subtitle Position is eased.

planted-dragged-up-small.json.note: T031, live (L-5): a hand drag straight up also moves the influence (Position 1.5 s in 32.115, Scale 26.963), so b passes and P1 and S fail a and d only; drag_sideways stays true under FR-012's rule as decided 2026-10-26 (a fails and the landing is under 53.33). The capture also has Position's 3 s and 4.367 s landings at speed 2.91 (influence 32.521 and 32.442, within 1 point of 33.33, so b fails too): the drag moved every selected key's handle, so P2 and P3 arrive moving as well.

planted-dragged-up-large.json.note: T031, live (L-5): dragged further from the small drag, so the 1.5 s landings keep the small drag's influence (b passes, a and d fail, drag_sideways true under FR-012 as decided 2026-10-26), and P2 and P3 keep its speed 2.91. P1's fastest part was 'last' (research R2's 1.0 peak on the stand-in); live, its speed 36.336 peaks at 0.65, by the two-thirds line, so middle and last, and the builder saw middle third by eye.

planted-one-scale-dim.json.note: T031, live (L-2, Lock Dimensions off): Title Position wasn't reset between the hand captures, so its 1.5 s landing still has the large drag (speed 36.336, influence 32.115) and P1 grades as in planted-dragged-up-large.json. This capture's subject is S.

planted-hold-in.json.note: T031, live (L-7): AE stores influence 16.667 on the hold side, so FR-010b (both facing sides within 1 point of 33.33) doesn't fail and the pair fails a and c; the mistake is still the hold side, since c comes first. Fastest is R2 on the stored influences (0.66, middle and last); what AE plays is a still title that jumps at 1.5 s, which R2 doesn't model (raised for the spec writer).

planted-shared-key.json.note: Pair 1's landing is shaped; pair 2 shares the 1.5 s key and isn't credited, and its start key's in side is pair 1's landing, so it isn't 'mixed up' (FR-013, D-3).

planted-easy-ease-again.json.note: T031, live (L-6, F9): Title Position wasn't reset between the hand captures, so its 1.5 s landing still has the large drag (speed 36.336, influence 32.115) and P1 grades as in planted-dragged-up-large.json. This capture's subject is S.
